methodNotes: Every account meta shown was read from a transaction message (encoding:json) and resolved through the header + meta.loadedAddresses, so writable/signer flags are the real ones the caller set. For INNER/CPI occurrences the pubkey ORDER is exactly what the caller passed to the CPI; the per-account is_signer/is_writable a CPI sets are not observable, so flags are reported only for top-level occurrences.
Nothing was signed, sent or simulated. Only getSignaturesForAddress / getTransaction / getAccountInfo / getMultipleAccounts were used, against https://api.mainnet-beta.solana.com .

derivationRules.quoteMint: BondingCurve has TWO live account lengths. A 124-byte curve reads all-zero at the quote_mint field (offset 83) and the transaction passes WSOL So111...112 with quote_token_program = TokenkegQfe... A 151-byte curve holds a real quote mint at offset 83 and the transaction passes exactly that mint, with quote_token_program = the owner of that mint account (Token-2022 in both non-SOL samples). Rule: quote_mint = curve.quote_mint unless it is the zero pubkey, in which case WSOL. Matched 13/13.
derivationRules.baseTokenProgram: owner of the base mint account. TokenzQdB (Token-2022) in 13/13 samples.
derivationRules.creatorVault: PDA(["creator-vault", BondingCurve.creator], pump) where BondingCurve.creator is read at the moment the transaction EXECUTES. See creatorVaultRaceProof: the one sample that did not reproduce from a later read is explained by a migrate_bonding_curve_creator that landed one slot after that trade.
derivationRules.feeRecipient: NOT derivable. It is a MEMBERSHIP choice from the Global account: fee_recipient, fee_recipients[0..6], reserved_fee_recipient, reserved_fee_recipients[0..6] — 16 pubkeys. 13/13 observed values were in that set. Four buy_v2 in ONE slot (446099884) used two different values, so it is the caller’s choice and not a slot- or time-derived rotation.
derivationRules.buybackFeeRecipient: NOT derivable. MEMBERSHIP choice from Global.buyback_fee_recipients[0..7]. 13/13 observed values were in that set; error 6057 BuybackFeeRecipientNotAuthorized is the program’s own membership check. Two different values were used in the same slot 446099884.
derivationRules.associatedBaseUser: The IDL declares NO pda for index 14, but the canonical ATA(user, base_token_program, base_mint) matched 13/13. An encoder passes its OWN token account here, so this position is under the caller’s control regardless.
derivationRules.sharingConfig: PDA(["sharing-config", base_mint]) derived under the FEE program pfeeUxB6jkeY1Hxd7CsFCAjcbHA9rWtchMGdZ6VojVZ — NOT under the pump program. Matched 13/13. The account is frequently UNINITIALIZED (does not exist on chain); the IDL says so explicitly and the address is still required.

creatorVaultRaceProof.whatHappened: The curve was created (create_v2) at slot 446099885 and migrate_bonding_curve_creator ran at slot 446099886, which rewrote BondingCurve.creator from the deployer to the sharing-config PDA. Every buy_v2 at or before 446099885 carried the vault seeded from the deployer; every buy_v2 from 446099889 on carried the vault seeded from the sharing-config PDA. No transaction ever carried the other one.
creatorVaultRaceProof.postMigrationCreator: BL3opBvWBtiXEiGwhBZD9Tx1doaMWYPoeXtiSF1o5dW9 (== the sharing-config PDA for this mint)
creatorVaultRaceProof.tradeEventCross_check: TradeEvent.creator in 5GzeJnAbRLPz (slot 446099885) = FDfyqqen...; in 3H2JoJ7Q7Zkg and 21DSEVnWt7rd (slot 446099890) = BL3opBvW... Each equals the seed that reproduces the observed index 16.
creatorVaultRaceProof.consequenceForAnEncoder: BondingCurve.creator is MUTABLE and it changed within one slot of a launch on an actively traded mint. An encoder must read the curve as late as possible and accept a race: if the creator migrates between the read and the landing, the creator_vault (and its ATA) in the already-signed transaction are stale.

accountExistenceProbe.note: getMultipleAccounts over the accounts of sample woKwM9eKz2vf, run after that transaction landed. Several derived positions DO NOT EXIST on chain; that is normal and is not evidence against the derivation.

results.7 associated_quote_fee_recipient: owner TokenkegQfe..., 165 bytes (a live WSOL token account)
results.12 associated_quote_bonding_curve: DOES NOT EXIST — the SOL-quote ATAs are opened and closed inside the transaction
results.14 associated_base_user: DOES NOT EXIST (buyer later closed it)
results.16 creator_vault: owner 11111111111111111111111111111111, 0 bytes, 50,847,090 lamports — a native-SOL vault PDA
results.18 sharing_config: DOES NOT EXIST — uninitialised, exactly as the IDL docs say it may be

failedTransactionScan.method: 182 FAILED transactions pulled from the pump program tape and decoded
failedTransactionScan.whatThisDoesNotShow: No transaction in any scan passed a WRONG account, so there is NO direct evidence about whether the deployed program enforces the declared seed constraint on creator_vault. If it does, a stale creator_vault fails the transaction (safe). If it does not, the creator fee is paid to the wrong PDA. THIS IS UNVERIFIED.

residualRisks: creator_vault / associated_creator_vault race: BondingCurve.creator is mutable (migrate_bonding_curve_creator, set_creator, admin_set_creator) and was observed changing ONE SLOT after a launch. Whether a stale value is rejected or silently misroutes the creator fee is UNVERIFIED (see failedTransactionScan).

fee_recipient and buyback_fee_recipient are membership picks, not derivations. The Global account must be re-read; if pump.fun rotates those arrays between the read and the landing, an authorised-at-read-time pick can become unauthorised.

buy_exact_quote_in_v2 (c2ab1c46684d5b2f) also carries 27 accounts in the SAME order, and its arguments are (quote_amount_in, min_base_out) — the OPPOSITE order to buy_v2 (amount, max_sol_cost). Account-count is not a safe discriminator between the two; only the 8-byte discriminator is.
Every sample was Token-2022 base (TokenzQdB...). No buy_v2 on a legacy-SPL base mint was observed, so the base_token_program = mint-owner rule is measured only on Token-2022.

Quote assets other than SOL are live: two of the seven mints were quoted in Xs151QeqTCiuKtinzfRATnUESM2xTU6V9Wy8Vy538ci and MGMuubtUEirmkhfEQdmGUh4pr7HuUdMWcZXFtpPbVJD, both Token-2022. A bot that assumes SOL will mis-size those trades even though the account list is right.

verdict.forWhichPositions: All 27. 25 are derivable from (mint, signer, program state) alone; 2 (index 6 fee_recipient, index 8 buyback_fee_recipient) are not derivable but are READ from named fields of the Global account and any member of those sets is accepted.
verdict.evidence: 13 independent buy_v2 occurrences, 13 distinct signers, 7 distinct mints, 8 top-level. 12 of 13 reproduced all 27 positions exactly. The 13th differs only at index 16/17 and is explained, with the migrate transaction and the TradeEvent creator field, by a creator migration that landed one slot later.
conditions: Read Global, the bonding curve, the mint and the quote mint immediately before building — the curve creator and the quote mint are both state, not constants.
Pick fee_recipient and buyback_fee_recipient from the Global arrays that were just read; do not hard-code them.
Match on the 8-byte discriminator b817ee6167c5d33d, never on the account count.
Treat the creator race as a live failure mode until enforcement of the seed constraint is proved.
